follow-up time: Until full enteral feeding was achieved
exposure: Age at initiation of trophic feeding
cohort: 282 low birth weight neonates admitted to six neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
finding: There is a delay in achieving full enteral feeding among LBW neonates, and several factors, including maternal education level, birth weight, and cesarean delivery, can affect the time to FEF.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was a significant predictor of delayed time to full enteral feeding in LBW neonates.
